title: 宝塚記念の後に・勝負の行方

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The head-to-head between the Otherworldly Front-Runner and the Empress has been settled! Air Groove is victorious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! She was sooo close!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Right? I don't know why, but I couldn't take my eyes off her!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch up!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, I was able to secure victory today…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But this is nothing like how I imagined!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You crossed the finish line after me, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Everyone only had eyes for you! All they cared about was you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I won the race, yet somehow I didn't surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka looked so powerful and free during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stole everyone's attention, and Air Groove is clearly sensitive to the fact she was outshone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare try and console me, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll do what I must. You do the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just promise me one thing: when I've grown strong enough to be worthy of the title of Empress…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And when that time comes, I will be challenging you once again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not shying away from Air Groove's blazing eyes, Silence Suzuka nods in solemn agreement.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and Silence Suzuka shake hands, sealing their promise to challenge each other once more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't think I'll forget what happened today for a long while…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I could hear Air Groove's heartbeat while we were racing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And I could feel her passion burning right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's precisely why I couldn't give up my lead to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka's eyes shine as if the passion that burned inside the Empress has spread, and smolders within her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to become even faster.
choice_data_list: We've got summer camp to get through first.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Good night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch as she enters the dorm. But just as I'm about to make my way home, a wail cuts through the air.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Por quuuuué?! I can't believe it! SUZUKAAA!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, it's late. Keep your voice down, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But… I was watching from the stands!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even though Suzuka didn't win, her performance totally blew me away!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It feels like there's no way I can beat her! This sucks! This sucks, this sucks, this sucks, this sucks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: How can I ever become the world's strongest racer now?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! You've got this, El! Fight! FIGHT! Run! Run! ÁNDALE!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sigh. El, you really need to keep it down.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She really took off like the wind, though, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtains open on a new challenge.
